display.title: Boss overview
display.subtitle: Where to find them
description: Six Cataclysm bosses each unlock one machine tier. Each structure below was checked against Cataclysm's data.
Craft the matching Eye (see JEI), which needs an Eye of Ender, and use it like an Eye of Ender to find the structure.
The GregTech Field Guide has a Boss Index: every boss starts as a ??? hint and its full entry unlocks when you defeat it.
